title: 26 妖贩子27 趋吉避凶
content_zh:
一人一猫在这天巍山中跪拜天道，宣誓结为异姓兄弟。
沈念此刻已经穿好衣物，看着眼前的萌货，他开口道：“团团，你家是住在天巍山脉之中吗？”
团团点头。
于是沈念继续道：“那你对这天巍山脉很是熟悉喽？”
自己与紫晚晴在这山中东躲西藏，还得寻找水云窟，若是有这萌货做个向导，那必定会事半功倍。
哪知听了沈念的话，团团的表情有些惆怅。
“我很少出门，所以一点儿也不熟悉。”
看来家教很严？
“那你这次怎么一个人在这里玩耍？”
“我是偷跑出来的，算是离家出走。”
“额......”
原来还是个叛逆公子哥。
"可是你对外面不熟，就不怕迷路？"
沈念说出了心中的困惑。
“弟弟，你真聪明，我确实迷路了.......”
说完它又从小背包中掏出了一根新鲜的竹笋，咯吱咯吱的咬起来。
看起来普通的背包，却似乎藏了数不清的物件，由此可见，这背包一定也是个了不得的法宝，它的空间远不像看起来的这般小。
正当兄弟二人闲聊之时，一个尖锐的声音传来，“熊公子，终于找到你了。”
一人一妖蓦然回首，只见一个长着鹰嘴的人形妖物往这边走来。
“妖...妖怪？”

沈念还是第一次亲眼见到这样的人妖，一时间有些惊慌。
那鹰妖也是一脸戒备的盯着沈念，皱着眉头说道：“熊公子，你怎的和一个人类待在一起？”
“这个人类是我弟弟。”
那鹰妖半信半疑，但也不去深究，转而对着团团说道：“熊公子，我是来接你出去的，咱们快走吧。”
听见这妖这般言语，沈念倒是松了一口气，刚才的第一反应，很担心又是一个为了誓杀令追杀自己的人。
看来这誓杀令还没有在天巍山广为传播，不仅团团不认识自己，这刚出现的妖也认不得。
团团有些兴奋，说道：“你就是来接我的妖怪吗？”
鹰妖点头答道：“正是，在下殷宝宝，受人所托接熊公子出山。”
沈念在杵在一旁，听了三言两语心中也大致明白，原来这团团因故离家出走，虽然它心思简单，又不认得路，但好在找好了帮手，有妖助它一臂之力。
只是这鹰妖的做法属实不妥，小孩子和家里闹别扭，你一个外人不劝着他回家就罢了，反而帮他出走，这不是火上浇油吗？
“弟弟，我要走了，你要不要与我一起，听说南国很好玩。”
团团很喜欢这个白捡的弟弟，发出了邀请。
“南国？”
闻言沈念微微一怔，紧接着他眉头不由皱起，这不就是万妖国吗？
由各类先天妖族聚居形成的国家。
这万妖国曾经可是大乾的死敌。
他瞪了一眼鹰妖，后者果然有些心虚般不敢看他。
团团说道：“是啊，阿牛说南国很好玩，比家里有趣多了。”
“可是，你之前了解过那里是什么地方吗？”
团团摇了摇头。

鹰妖不耐烦的插话道：“去了不就知道了，熊公子，我们快走吧，不要耽搁了。”
content_en:
One man and one cat knelt down to worship Heaven in this majestic mountain and swore to become brothers of different surnames.
Shen Nian had already put on his clothes. Looking at the cute guy in front of him, he said, "Tuan Tuan, does your family live in the Tianwei Mountains?"
Tuantuan nodded.
So Shen Nian continued: "Then you are very familiar with the Tianwei Mountains?"
I and Zi Wanqing were hiding in the middle of the mountain and had to find Shuiyun Cave. If I had this cute guy as a guide, I would get twice the result with half the effort.
Unexpectedly, after listening to Shen Nian's words, Tuan Tuan's expression was a little melancholy.
"I rarely go out, so I'm not familiar with it at all."
It seems that the tutor is very strict?
"Then why are you playing here alone this time?"
"I ran away secretly. I ran away from home."
"Um..."
Turns out he is still a rebellious young man.
"But you're not familiar with the outside world, so you're not afraid of getting lost?"
Shen Nian expressed his confusion.
"Brother, you are so smart, I am indeed lost..."
After saying that, it took out a fresh bamboo shoot from its small backpack and chewed it.
It looks like an ordinary backpack, but it seems to hide countless items. From this, it can be seen that this backpack must also be an incredible magic weapon. Its space is not as small as it seems.
While the two brothers were chatting, a sharp voice came, "Mr. Xiong, I finally found you."
One person and one monster suddenly looked back and saw a humanoid monster with an eagle beak walking towards this side.
"Ya...youkai?"
It was the first time for Shen Nian to see such a transvestite with his own eyes, and he was a little panicked for a moment.
The hawk demon also stared at Shen Nian with a wary expression, frowned and said, "Mr. Xiong, why do you stay with a human?"
"This human is my brother."
The hawk demon was dubious, but he didn't go into details. He turned to Tuantuan and said, "Mr. Xiong, I'm here to take you out. Let's leave quickly."
Hearing the demon's words, Shen Nian breathed a sigh of relief. His first reaction was that he was worried about another person chasing him for the killing order.
It seems that this order to kill has not been widely spread in Tianwei Mountain. Not only does Tuantuan not recognize himself, but he also does not recognize the demon that has just appeared.
Tuantuan was a little excited and said, "Are you the monster who came to pick me up?"
The hawk demon nodded and replied: "Exactly, I am Yin Baobao, who has been entrusted by someone to take Mr. Xiong out of the mountain."
Shen Nian stood aside, and after listening to a few words, he roughly understood that Tuantuan ran away from home for some reason. Although he was simple-minded and didn't know the way, luckily he found a helper and a demon helped him.
It's just that what this harpy did is really inappropriate. The child is having trouble with the family, and you, an outsider, don't just persuade him to go home, but instead help him run away. Isn't this adding fuel to the fire?
"Brother, I'm leaving. Do you want to come with me? I heard that the South Country is very fun."
Tuantuan liked this little brother who was picked up for free and extended an invitation.
"Southern Country?"
Hearing this, Shen Nian was slightly startled, and then he couldn't help but frown. Isn't this the Kingdom of Ten Thousand Monsters?
A country formed by various innate demon clans living together.
This country of ten thousand demons was once the mortal enemy of Da Gan.
He glared at the harpy, who did not dare to look at him as if he felt guilty.
Tuantuan said: "Yes, A Niu said that the southern country is very interesting, much more interesting than at home."
"But, have you ever known where that place is?"
Tuantuan shook his head.
The hawk demon impatiently interrupted: "We'll find out when we get there, Mr. Xiong, let's leave quickly, don't delay."
